explanation: In the 1520s the Portuguese traveller Domingo Paes said it was as large as Rome. It was sacked in 1565, after its army lost the Battle of Talikota.

claims.text: Hampi was the capital of the Vijayanagara Empire in southern India.
The Mughal, Chola and Maratha empires were not ruled from Hampi.
The Portuguese traveller Domingo Paes, who visited in the early 1520s, compared the city's size to Rome.
Vijayanagara was sacked in 1565 after the Battle of Talikota.
